name: Cetilar
verdict: A brand of PharmaNutra S.p.A. (Euronext STAR Milan). Nothing found.
note: Team partner of Ferrari-AF Corse per Ferrari's announcement of 21 February 2024 (ferrari.com/en-EN/hypercar/articles/cetilar-reconfirmed-as-team-partner-of-ferrari-af-corse); the Cetilar wordmark appears on the official Ferrari Hypercar partners board for 2026 and on the 2026 499P livery. Rating note: owner PharmaNutra S.p.A. is listed on Euronext STAR Milan; its relevant shareholders are the Lacorte family and Carlo Volpi - private Italian individuals, no state stake and no human-rights finding located.
